```python
def compare_versions(a: str, b: str) -> int:
    pa = a.split(".")
    pb = b.split(".")
    n = max(len(pa), len(pb))
    for i in range(n):
        ca = pa[i].lstrip("0") if i < len(pa) else ""
        cb = pb[i].lstrip("0") if i < len(pb) else ""
        if len(ca) != len(cb):
            return 1 if len(ca) > len(cb) else -1
        if ca != cb:
            return 1 if ca > cb else -1
    return 0
```
